text:
The diarrhea is most likely caused by nontyphoidal Salmonella. Hektoen enteric agar recovers Salmonella and Shigella, and repeated antibiotics plus vague generalized pain without dysentery favor Salmonella over Shigella. Clostridioides difficile is the usual post-antibiotic concern, but it is not recovered on this medium.

CONFIDENCE: 74
